steps: Freeze derivation, expected behavior and falsifier before edits; derive all physical quantities from the accepted source chain.
Read the winning package-preflight module and identified current packager entry point.

Implement a manifest producer/adapter using the packager actual declared inputs, relative paths and file hashes. Keep license/admission decisions explicit and external; never include unapproved assets.
Test relocation, missing assets and undeclared development paths in a synthetic minimal package. Do not publish a game package or claim commercial rights.
tasks.falsifier: A missing predecessor fact is fabricated, a fixture is labeled native acceptance, or the patch changes unscoped physics/thresholds.
tasks.completion: Lead-reviewed merged PR containing actual implementation/patch and relevant tests; preserve runtime/visual gates not yet exercised.
tasks.limits: Own attempt workspace only. Source reads from winning pinned evidence. No GPU, training, process termination, live checkout edits, model/mesh copying or unapproved threshold changes.

tasks.objective: Connect accepted player diagnostics to current feedback responses
read_first: Winning merged PR, source references and inbox of I-S04-PLAYER-DIAGNOSTICS
steps: Freeze derivation, expected behavior and falsifier before edits; derive all physical quantities from the accepted source chain.
Read the winning diagnostics module and current state_feedback/session/input error paths.

Implement a narrow adapter from actual product errors to the accepted player messages, preserving unknown/error correlation and supported-action checks. Avoid rewriting the vocabulary or claiming unsupported movement.
Test exact source-derived known failures and path-bearing unknown errors, and publish a scoped integration patch plus user-visible samples for later human review.
tasks.falsifier: A missing predecessor fact is fabricated, a fixture is labeled native acceptance, or the patch changes unscoped physics/thresholds.
tasks.completion: Lead-reviewed merged PR containing actual implementation/patch and relevant tests; preserve runtime/visual gates not yet exercised.
tasks.limits: Own attempt workspace only. Source reads from winning pinned evidence. No GPU, training, process termination, live checkout edits, model/mesh copying or unapproved threshold changes.
